name: VMware vSphere and VMware Cloud Foundation
certifications: VMware Certified Professional - Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV)
VMware Certified Professional - VMware vSphere Foundation Administrator (VCP-VVF)
VMware Certified Professional - VMware Cloud Foundation Administrator (VCP-VCF)

beginner.summary: For system administrators, support engineers and freshers moving into data centre roles. Covers virtualisation concepts and a nested lab, installing ESXi, deploying vCenter, building the inventory, creating virtual machines, VMware Tools, templates and content libraries, standard switches, VMFS, NFS and iSCSI storage, vMotion, snapshots and clones, resource controls and pools, vSphere HA and DRS, roles and permissions, performance charts and alarms, logs and everyday troubleshooting, patching with vSphere Lifecycle Manager and backups.
prerequisites: Comfortable with Windows or Linux server administration
Knows IP addressing, VLANs, DNS and DHCP
A laptop with 32 GB RAM or access to a lab server for nested ESXi
outcomes: Install and configure ESXi hosts and vCenter Server
Create, migrate, protect and patch virtual machines
Configure networking, storage, HA and DRS for a small cluster
Monitor, troubleshoot and back up a vSphere environment

advanced.summary: For senior VMware engineers, architects and platform leads. Covers VCF architecture and workload domains, NSX overlay networking and micro-segmentation, cluster design, capacity planning with VCF Operations, private cloud automation with VCF Automation and Terraform, multi-site disaster recovery, vSAN stretched clusters, performance engineering for NUMA, latency-sensitive and GPU workloads, compliance automation, ransomware resilience, hybrid cloud on hyperscalers, HCX migrations, Broadcom licensing and cost, exit planning, multi-tenant Kubernetes, observability, fleet lifecycle with SDDC Manager, deep troubleshooting and platform strategy.
